meta.name: pr-to-video
meta.description: Turn a GitHub pull request (a PR URL, owner/repo#N, or 'this PR' in a checked-out repo) into a code-change explainer video — changelog, feature reveal, fix, or refactor walkthrough built from the diff, commits, and files: the input is a code change, not a website. Not a product promo (/product-launch-video) or a no-PR topic explainer (/faceless-explainer). Unclear → /hyperframes.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 把一次代码改动做成一集讲解视频,讲清改了什么
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果每次发版都要向非技术的同事解释改了什么
copy.tagline_en: Turn a code change into a short explainer video of what changed
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you must explain code changes to non-technical teammates

howto.what: 把 GitHub pull request 变成讲解这次代码改动的视频:读取 diff、commit 和文件,按分镜逐帧用 HyperFrames 渲染出 mp4,片尾带贡献者头像。不抓取网站。
howto.when: 当你给出 PR 链接、owner/repo#N,或在已检出的仓库里说「这个 PR」时触发。它只处理代码改动,不是产品宣传,也不是没有 PR 的话题讲解。

say.note: 指定声音会通过 --voice 传入

howto.what_en: Turns a GitHub pull request into a code-change explainer video: reads the diff, commits and files, then renders frames to mp4 with HyperFrames, with contributor avatars in the credits. No website capture.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you give a PR URL, an owner/repo#N ref, or say "this PR" in a checked-out repo. It handles code changes only, not product promos or no-PR topic explainers.

say_en.text: Turn this PR (owner/repo#1842) into an explainer video
say_en.note: Fetches PR facts, then drafts a storyboard for approval

say_en.text: Make an explainer for owner/repo#1842, male voiceover
say_en.note: A named voice is passed with --voice

say_en.text: Show me the storyboard draft for this refactor PR
